Quality measures of a self-organising map

Source: R/som_functions.R
eemsom_quality.Rd

Quality measures of a self-organising map

Usage

eemsom_quality(som)

Arguments

som

object of class eemsom, see eemsom

Value

data frame with one row

Details

  • quantisation_error: mean Euclidean distance between samples and their prototypes, see eemsom_samples for the handling of missing values

  • topographic_error: share of samples whose best and second best matching units are not neighbours (six neighbours on hexagonal maps, eight including the diagonals on rectangular maps, see unit.distances)

  • explained_variance: share of the total sum of squares of the (normalised) data explained by the prototypes

References

Kohonen, T. (2013). Essentials of the self-organizing map. Neural Networks 37, 52-65. doi:10.1016/j.neunet.2012.09.018

See also

Other map results: eemsom_codes(), eemsom_predict(), eemsom_samples(), eemsom_split()

Examples

data(eem_list)

som <- eemsom(eem_list, rlen = 100, seed = 42)
eemsom_quality(som)
#>   quantisation_error topographic_error explained_variance
#> 1           6.802709                 0          0.9473782
